utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m a little behind—can you tell me where it’s happening and when it starts?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I don’t have the exact place and time yet, but I’ll pass along the updates as soon as I hear them. I’ll make sure folks know when it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Vik — just let me know when you get the place and start time. I’ll keep an eye out for the update.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s now on Sunday at the community center, and I’m still confirming the start time. If you need the closest route for pickup, I can help map that out too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — if you can send the start time when it’s confirmed, I’ll fit it around pickup. The route help would be great too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Faye — I’ll send the start time as soon as it’s confirmed and I’ll help map the best pickup route too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help out; just tell me what needs fixing and where to bring it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I can take the gate latch and help patch up that porch step. Just point me to where I should start.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks, Sam. Start with the porch step, and I’ll point you over to the gate latch after that.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll make sure everyone knows it’s for the repair drive, not a regular block meetup. I’m spreading the word to the neighbors now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good—thanks for clarifying. I’m a little behind, but I’ll keep an eye out for the exact time and the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No problem—I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure it’s clearly about the repair drive. Just send me the exact time when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira — any tools you can bring would be a big help. I’ll see you at the community center for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can bring whatever I find while I’m out running errands. See you at the community center, and I’ll keep an eye out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira — that’s really helpful. I’ll let you know if there are any updates before we meet at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m on it—I’ll spread the word and ask neighbors to check their sheds and garages for hand tools, extension cords, and spare bike parts.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Quinn. That covers it—just ask folks to label anything they can spare and bring it by Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it—I’ll make sure everyone labels what they can spare and brings it by Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I’m late—did I miss anything important about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No, just that I could use a few small fixes around the house, and I’ll make sure they know it’s for the repair drive. I really appreciate you checking in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli. Just let me know what needs doing, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s going well—people have been dropping off all kinds of odds and ends already. If you want, I can tell you what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes please—I'm still hearing things second-hand, so I'd love the update on what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—last I heard they still need hand tools, spare lumber, and a few more cash donations. I can keep my ears open and let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you hear back on the pickup time yet? I can bring the wrench set when it’s best.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Not yet, but I’m glad to have the wrench set ready. If you can bring it when you come, we’ll be set to start as soon as they confirm the pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure thing—I’ll bring the wrench set when I come. Just let me know as soon as they confirm the pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good to hear. I’ll make a quick list and see what needs fixing most.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds good—if you send me the list, I’ll double-check the details and help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Hana. I’ll write it up tonight and bring it by tomorrow so you can check it over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m around if you need an extra pair of hands or any tools. Just let me know what’s still short.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey—I appreciate that. I’ll let you know if we need anything specific, and I’ll keep tallying the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course—just keep me posted, and I’ll be ready to help out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Do you know the exact location and start time for the repair drive? I’m trying to figure out the closest spot to the school pickup route.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure of the exact spot yet, but yes, the repair drive is still on. Once we have the pickup time, we can sort out the tools too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks — if you get the exact location or pickup time, let me know and I can plan the closest route.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can ask around too, and I’ll bring what tools I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be great, Rey—thanks. I’ll keep passing the word along and let you know as soon as I hear the time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good—just let me know when and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I think it’s at the community center, but I’m fuzzy on the time. Do you want me to double-check the exact start time?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that’d be great—please double-check the start time for me. I can help with donations and supplies once I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I’ll check the start time and let you know. Community center for now, and I’ll get you the exact time as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on, right? When do you want the drop-off to happen?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, it’s still on—I’m just a little fuzzy on the timing. What do you want me to bring for drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I just want to confirm the drop-off time first, then we can sort out what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still happening — I just want to make sure the timing and drop-off plan are clear first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help with that—do you know the exact location and start time for the repair drive? I’m trying to figure out the closest spot to the school pickup route.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet — I’m still waiting on the exact location and start time. Once I have those, I can line up the drop-off and tools more easily.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard anything new yet, but I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear a pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. Let me know when you hear a pickup time, and I’ll be ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll check while I’m out and let you know as soon as I hear a pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa—I'll keep tallying the supplies and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Cleo — I’ll note that the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now. Keep me posted on the supplies, and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it, Rosa—Sunday at the community center works. I’ll keep tracking the supplies and let you know if we’re short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please do—just make sure they know it’s for the repair drive and not a regular block meetup.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll make it clear it’s for the repair drive, not a regular block meetup, and I’ll keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be really helpful.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll ask around and pass along any repair requests or extra tools I hear about.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Nell — thanks for keeping an ear out. If anyone needs a tool or has a small fix, send them my way and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do, Gus — I’ll let folks know to send you their repair requests. If I hear of any extra tools or small fixes, I’ll pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll make sure everyone knows it’s for the repair drive, not just a regular meetup. Once you have the time set, I’ll spread the word to the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Jules. Just let me know the time once it’s set, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — as soon as the time’s set, I’ll pass it along to everyone for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s picking up nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and cash all morning. If you need anything fixed, now’s a good time to ask around.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Nice, I’ll ask around for any loose boards or leaky faucets. Thanks for the update.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll keep my ears open too. If I hear of any other repairs or donations needed, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks—once you have the school schedule, bring it over and I’ll line up a time for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—I’ll bring the school schedule over as soon as I have it. Just let me know where to drop it off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Just bring it by my place, and I’ll take it from there once you have it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Mina — any tools you can bring and any handy folks you can point my way will really help the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can bring a wrench set and help out for a bit—what time do you need me there?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be great, Mina — could you come by at 10 and stay if you’re able? Thanks for helping out with the repair drive.
